description: NDJSON IPC protocol between mouser GUI (Python) and deskflow-core daemon (C++). Each message is one JSON object per line. GUI writes to daemon stdin; daemon writes to stderr. See spec/mouser 'Integration layer' and plan/mouser 阶段 2.

Hello.description: Daemon -> GUI. Sent once on startup after process initialization.

fields.version: string  — protocol version (matches this schema's version)

Start.description: GUI -> Daemon. Instructs daemon to begin server or client operation with the given config.

Stop.description: GUI -> Daemon. Instructs daemon to cleanly shut down (equivalent to SIGTERM but cross-platform).

Status.description: Daemon -> GUI. Emitted whenever connection state changes.

Error.description: Daemon -> GUI. Emitted on recoverable errors (e.g. Accessibility not granted, port in use).

ClipboardUpdate.description: Daemon -> GUI. Emitted when clipboard text changes on the active screen (v1: plain text only).

Ping.description: GUI -> Daemon. Heartbeat probe. GUI sends every 5s; 3 consecutive misses = daemon hung.

Pong.description: Daemon -> GUI. Heartbeat response to Ping.
